title: Clinical Research of H3F3AK27M in Spinal Glioma and Its Impact on TMZ Chemoradiotherapy
brief_summary: H3F3AK27M may be a feature of primary spinal cord glioma and affect the outcome and prognosis of TMZ chemoradiotherapy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Surgical treatment and pathological confirmation of spinal glioma in our department and is the first case without any treatment before operation.

Exclusion Criteria:

* The tumor is recurrent or has been treated before operation.
study_population: Surgical treatment and pathological confirmation of spinal glioma in our department.
